title: Glencore achieves land access for the Coroccohuayco project at Antapaccay
gist: Glencore's Antapaccay has finished land-access agreements for the brownfield Coroccohuayco copper project in Peru, with first production expected H2 2029 and mine life extended past 40 years.

insights.claim: Antapaccay has completed the access agreements for the last blocks of land needed to unlock the brownfield Coroccohuayco copper project in Espinar, Cusco, Peru.
insights.speaker: Glencore
insights.so_what: Removes a key social-licence obstacle for new Peruvian copper supply.

insights.claim: First production from Coroccohuayco is expected in H2 2029, subject to securing final permits.
insights.speaker: Glencore
insights.so_what: Adds copper supply in 2029 and beyond; watch the final permits.

insights.claim: Coroccohuayco is expected to extend Antapaccay's life of mine to over 40 years and significantly increase future copper production, and follows MEIA environmental approval received earlier in the year.
insights.speaker: Glencore
insights.locator: Luis Rivera and Jon Evans statements
